title: My unemployed Dachshund who loafs, Jimmy Ween
text: My unemployed Dachshund who loafs, Jimmy Ween, sausage dog. I lubs him. https://t.co/QC13ZKbRg4
blurb: Meet Jimmy Ween, a proudly unemployed loafer with just his face poking out from under a spooky Halloween blanket. His human's verdict on this sausage dog: "I lubs him."
